categories.name: Blackwork
categories.description: Bold, solid ink work that uses pure black to create striking contrast. From geometric patterns to large-scale coverage, blackwork turns skin into graphic art — no gray areas, no hesitation.

categories.name: Realism
categories.description: Skin becomes canvas. Portraits, nature, objects rendered with photographic precision — every shadow, every highlight placed to trick the eye into seeing depth where there's only ink.

categories.name: Fine Line
categories.description: Delicate, single-needle precision. Thin, clean strokes that create intricate detail without weight. Subtle enough to feel like a whisper on the skin, sharp enough to last.

categories.name: Custom Design
categories.description: Your story, built from zero. No flash, no repeats — every piece is drawn for your body, your idea, your intention. The artist interprets, you approve, and the result exists only once.

artists.name: Sandro Martins
artists.specialty: Blackwork, Realism, Fine Line, Custom Design
